auth_info:
Fill in authentication credentials of your robot or retrieve following the subsequent steps.
ATTENTION: The authentication credentials are not the same as you are using in the smartphone app!
authStep1: 1. Make sure this Adapter is started.
authStep2: 2. Make sure your robot is on the Home Base and powered on (green lights on).
authStep3: 3. Then press and hold the HOME button on your robot until it plays a series of tones (about 2 seconds).
authStep4: 4. Release the button and your robot will flash WIFI light.
authStep5: 5. Then come back here and press the button to retrieve IP and credentials.
refresh: Refresh time (in sec.) preferences will be retrieved from robot
